Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. As long as either a card with [Menoa Bellucci] in its name or a Digimon card with [Eosmon] in its name are among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: I use this card’s effect to reveal 5 cards. If the cards revealed only include either a card with [Menoa Bellucci] in its name or a Digimon card with [Eosmon] in its name, can I still add a card to my hand?

Effect: [On Deletion] Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Menoa Bellucci] and 1 Digimon card with [Eosmon] in its name among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
